title: WhatsApp Meta AI Incognito Mode Launch
caption: Meta just launched incognito mode for WhatsApp AI chats — end-to-end encrypted, no memory, no training data. The catch? It's buried in settings. Here's what changed and why it matters.

slides.headline: WhatsApp AI now has an incognito mode
slides.sub: End-to-end encrypted chats that leave no trace

slides.title: What actually changed
slides.body: WhatsApp users can now toggle incognito mode for Meta AI conversations. When active, chats are end-to-end encrypted, Meta AI forgets everything after the session ends, and nothing feeds back into training data. It's a manual opt-in for every conversation.
Meta rolled this out globally across WhatsApp's entire user base. That's more privacy-conscious AI conversations than any other platform offers at scale.

slides.title: What Meta didn't advertise
bullets: Incognito mode isn't default — you manually toggle it per chat
Most users won't know it exists unless they dig into settings
Switching mid-conversation resets all context immediately

audiences.body: Asking Meta AI about symptoms or sensitive medical questions without creating a permanent record
Getting quick calculations or explainers on loans, taxes, or budgets that stay ephemeral
Venting or exploring tough personal decisions without Meta storing the context
